review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: For the river update f(x)=x+digit_sum(x), f(x) is congruent to 2x modulo 9. Hence the residue classes split into the disjoint invariant sets {0}, {3,6}, and {1,2,4,5,7,8}, corresponding to canonical starts 9,3,1. A query cannot intersect either of the other two canonical rivers. Merge its strictly increasing sequence with the selected canonical sequence, always advancing the smaller value, to find the first equality. Reuse canonical prefixes across sorted queries and binary-search their initial positions; never replace the actual digit-sum recurrence with a heuristic jump. A precomputed five-digit chunk sum accelerates exact arbitrary-size digit sums, and output order is restored.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
